direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale feels like a low-budget indie comedy; the direction on a microscale is surprisingly good, as the chemistry within the cast and the comedy make this movie entertaining; the storytelling is standard for an indie, low-budget comedy

performance.comments: He's fully morphed into his brother James because this is basically a character I could see him play; has pretty good chemistry with the cast and holds his own in the comedic moments
the moral compass for this movie cause he's trying to do the right thing, even though he can be flawed himself; has pretty good chemistry with the cast
Basically just plays the bratty rich troubled kid; has pretty good chemistry with the cast
Feels like they just wanted a big name attached to this movie and got him; pretty small role, but makes the most out of it
I really don't know why she was cast in this movie cause its a pretty small role and doesn't feel like it uses her strengths, but she's still fine in the short time she's given
Pretty small role, but makes the most out of it by using his comedic talent

cast.comments: Kinda smaller cast but everyone plays their role well as they help tell their chapter in this longer story

story.comments: The concept is basically a road comedy following a group of strangers who are flawed people trying to do right; the plot structure is standard for a road comedy, where each stop feels like a chapter; the character writing is good, as you understand the motivations of the two leads and their transportation

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is good; the humor is funny and unique, which is something you definitely need for a low-budget indie comedy to stand out; the symbolism centers on the intent to do better, as each character has their own motivation to improve their life despite how flawed they might be; the foreshadowing is decent

visual_effects.comments: pretty low-budget and indie; kinda adds to the charm of the movie

makeup.comments: kinda feels low-budget, but also helps paint these characters, especially Dinklage and Braun

review.pacing: Pacing is appropriate, being neither too fast nor too slow, though a few of the chapters could have been shortened to make the movie feel tighter; the ending drags because it is not as strong as the middle of the movie
review.climax: Climax is executed well but is not as strong as the rest of the movie, which makes the film drag slightly toward this point
review.tone: Tone is very much that of a low-budget indie road comedy, especially regarding the eccentric nature of some of the jokes
review.final_notes: Saw the premiere at SXSW; the film was originally titled 'The Shitheads'
review.overall: Overall, 'Idiots' is an entertaining and funny indie road comedy that makes the most of its low budget through humor that is not afraid to be out there; while it does not feel original, the movie provides many laughs and has a talented cast that keeps you invested on the trip these characters go on
